feature: Regex match operator =~ — search semantics (substring; anchor with ^...$), Postgres ARE/POSIX-family

scenarios.name: default search semantics — case-sensitive substring on spine name
scenarios.query: MATCH (n:pg_node) WHERE n.name =~ "githubusercontent" RETURN n.name AS name ORDER BY name

scenarios.name: case-insensitive search via inline (?i) flag
scenarios.query: MATCH (n:pg_node) WHERE n.name =~ "(?i)githubusercontent" RETURN n.name AS name ORDER BY name

scenarios.name: explicit ^...$ anchors — full-string match
scenarios.query: MATCH (n:pg_node) WHERE n.name =~ "^https://token\\.actions\\.githubusercontent\\.com$" RETURN n.name AS name ORDER BY name

scenarios.name: escaped dot — \. matches literal '.', so 'Xcom' does not match
scenarios.query: MATCH (n:pg_node) WHERE n.name =~ "githubusercontent\\.com" RETURN n.name AS name ORDER BY name

scenarios.name: parameterized pattern — $pattern resolves to a regex string at execution
scenarios.query: MATCH (n:pg_node) WHERE n.name =~ $pattern RETURN n.name AS name ORDER BY name

scenarios.name: data-lane path — JSON key tags.url; missing key is NULL and drops the row
scenarios.query: MATCH (n:pg_node) WHERE n.data.tags.url =~ "github" RETURN n.name AS name ORDER BY name

scenarios.name: NULL pattern — $pattern resolves to null; row set is empty, no crash
scenarios.query: MATCH (n:pg_node) WHERE n.name =~ $pattern RETURN n.name AS name ORDER BY name

scenarios.name: AND composition — regex on spine name AND scalar = on data.kind
scenarios.query: MATCH (n:pg_node) WHERE n.name =~ "(?i)github" AND n.data.kind = "identity_provider" RETURN n.name AS name ORDER BY name

scenarios.name: NOT composition — NOT (name =~ '(?i)token') excludes the token-bearing rows
scenarios.query: MATCH (n:pg_node) WHERE NOT (n.name =~ "(?i)token") RETURN n.name AS name ORDER BY name

scenarios.name: spine entity_type path — regex on the registered-type column
scenarios.query: MATCH (n:pg_node) WHERE n.entity_type =~ "^pg_" RETURN n.name AS name ORDER BY name
